overview_description.description: Viewit is a property technology company that develops video-first real estate listing and property discovery platforms. The company provides mobile and web-based tools that allow real estate agents and agencies to create, upload, manage, and distribute property listings using video walkthroughs, geo-tagging, and AI-powered content generation. Its services are designed for residential and commercial property sales and rentals across markets including the UAE, the UK, and Pakistan.
